summary_en: Aiphone revised its treasury stock basic policy on November 10, 2026, eliminating the 7% holding limit on treasury shares. The company will now retire treasury shares opportunistically when they are no longer needed for strategic purposes, prioritizing capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Changes to Basic Policy on Acquisition, Holding and Retirement of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Aiphone's Board of Directors approved a revision to its basic policy on treasury shares, removing the previous ceiling of 7% of issued shares on holdings. Under the prior policy, the company maintained treasury shares to secure funds for strategic business investments such as M&A and business alliances, with the holding limit to be achieved through gradual retirement during the eighth medium-term business plan period (fiscal years ending March 2024 through March 2026).

The revised policy continues to authorize the holding of treasury shares for strategic purposes, including securing investment capital for business partnerships and acquisitions. However, the specific 7% upper limit on holdings has been eliminated to enable more flexible capital management. Going forward, Aiphone will retire treasury shares at appropriate times when they are no longer expected to be used, rather than maintaining a fixed maximum threshold.

The company described this change as necessary to realize more agile capital policies in response to changing business environments and to enhance capital efficiency—a key management priority. The revision does not alter the fundamental approach of acquiring treasury shares as part of capital allocation and shareholder returns; it instead provides greater operational flexibility for determining when and how much to retire.
